events.title: Pisgah Rage Pre-season
events.description: Runs 15 Oct 2026 to 1 Dec 2026. Pre-season activities including social events, rider assessment, bike shop night, parent meeting, and adventure rides in Bent Creek or Dupont

events.title: Pisgah Rage Regular Season
events.description: Runs 1 Dec 2026 to 30 May 2027. Regular season racing and training. Races start in March with 5-6 races across North Carolina through end of May. Practice schedule varies by month: January has indoor training; February has 1 weekend practice per week; March-May has 2 rides per week
